name: Extract fan plan mark
summary: Plan mark for a wall or ceiling extract fan, drawn as a fan circle with an outward airflow arrow.
description: Extract fans in bathrooms, kitchens and plant rooms are drawn as a circle containing fan blades or a cross, with an arrow showing airflow out of the room. The symbol is often linked to a light switch, an overrun timer or a humidistat.

The electrician needs to know the control method because it affects wiring: a fan run from the lighting circuit with an overrun timer needs a switched and a permanent live, while a humidistat fan may only need a permanent supply. The symbol does not state airflow rate or duct size, which are mechanical design items.
readingNotes: Read the control method: switched, timer overrun, humidistat or continuous.
Check for an isolator or fused connection unit.
drawingChecklist: Coordinate duct route with mechanical drawings.
distinction: A ceiling sweep fan circulates air; an extract fan removes it to outside.
